content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the WCDC Bihar Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WCDC Bihar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for WCDC Bihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is conducted by the Women and Child Development Corporation Bihar (WCDC Bihar) for filling various state project manager, accountant, and assistant positions across the state.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for various posts including State Project Manager, Accountant, and Assistant under advertisement number 02/2026.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application link for WCDC Bihar Recruitment 2026 officially opens on 1 October 2026 for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 6 November 2026. Candidates must complete their submissions well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Assistant post must be a Graduate in any faculty with knowledge of typing in Hindi and English on a computer, along with minimum 3 years of experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for State Project Manager posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for State Project Manager posts will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 60,362 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: No, the application fee for General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates is Nil as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The general maximum age limit is set at 42 years, with specific age relaxations provided for reserved categories and female candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for WCDC Bihar positions?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a merit list based on educational qualifications, additional qualifications, experience, interview, shortlisting for counseling, and document verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for the WCDC Bihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of WCDC Bihar at https://wcdc.bihar.gov.in/ or by using the direct application links provided above.
